description: Conveyor CV-101 stopped during packaging line operation. Operator reported motor humming, overload relay tripped, and belt would not restart after reset.
Monthly preventive inspection of centrifugal pump P-204 including bearing temperature check, seal leak inspection, coupling alignment, and vibration reading.
Air compressor AC-02 failed to maintain plant air pressure. Discharge temperature high and oil carryover visible at downstream filter drain.
Mixer MX-310 making intermittent grinding noise during startup. Gearbox oil sample shows metallic particles and elevated iron count.
Replace worn photoelectric sensor on palletizer PL-07 after repeated false jams at infeed gate.
Quarterly service of HVAC unit AHU-3: replace filters, inspect fan belt tension, clean condensate pan, and verify thermostat calibration.
Boiler feedwater pump P-118 leaking from mechanical seal. Water observed around pump base and seal flush line pressure fluctuating.
Filler machine FL-22 emergency stop circuit fault. HMI shows safety relay channel 2 discrepancy and machine cannot reset.
Forklift FLT-05 scheduled 500-hour maintenance including hydraulic hose inspection, brake check, mast lubrication, and battery electrolyte check.
Cooling tower CT-1 fan vibration alarm exceeded limit. Inspection found loose motor mount bolts and cracked fan blade root.
Packaging scale SC-14 drifting outside tolerance. Calibration weights show inconsistent readings and load cell cable has damaged insulation.
Robotic arm RB-3 stopped mid-cycle with servo drive fault E-32. Axis 4 brake not releasing and encoder feedback unstable.
Preventive lubrication route for conveyors CV-201 through CV-208. Grease head and tail pulley bearings and inspect belt tracking.
Chiller CH-02 low suction pressure alarm. Evaporator sight glass shows bubbles and compressor short cycling under normal load.
Dust collector DC-6 pulse cleaning ineffective. Differential pressure remains high and several filter bags appear blinded with powder buildup.
Labeler LB-11 missed labels on every third bottle. Stepper motor stalls briefly and label web tension fluctuates.
Annual inspection of fire pump FP-01 including churn test, diesel engine battery check, controller alarm verification, and jockey pump review.
Heat exchanger HX-9 not reaching outlet temperature target. Steam trap found cold and condensate backing up in return line.
Extruder EX-4 barrel zone 3 temperature unstable. Heater contactor chatter observed and thermocouple reading drops intermittently.
Wastewater pump P-330 tripped on overload overnight. Pump casing hot, impeller difficult to rotate, and rags found at suction screen.
Preventive inspection of electrical panel MCC-2: thermal scan, torque check on accessible terminals, clean cabinet, and verify ventilation fan.
Oven OV-5 conveyor speed fluctuates during production. VFD output current spikes and tachometer feedback signal drops out.
CIP skid valve XV-44 stuck closed during rinse cycle. Actuator air pressure normal but position feedback remains closed.
Replace cracked sight glass on tank TK-12 after operator noticed minor seepage around lower gasket.
Scheduled calibration of pressure transmitters PT-101, PT-102, and PT-103 on boiler header.
Case erector CE-2 magazine fails to feed cartons. Vacuum cups worn and vacuum pressure drops when pick arm extends.
Granulator GR-8 vibration increased sharply and screen deck bolts found sheared after jam event.
Preventive maintenance for nitrogen generator NG-1 including filter replacement, oxygen analyzer check, and valve leak test.
Transfer pump P-410 producing low flow to blending tank. Suction strainer partially blocked and pump cavitation noise present.
Automatic door DR-03 opens slowly and reverses before fully closing. Track rollers worn and obstruction sensor lens dirty.
